text:
alex: Flagging a creds leak from a partner ingestion pipeline into staging logs (partner=beta-bridge). Saw service tokens and a few wrapped/unwrapped entries. Starting triage.

priya: Can you paste one sanitized example and the log path? Also did you run a quick grep to estimate scope?

alex: Sample (sanitized): `timestamp=2026-04-02 svc_token=ya29.[REDACTED] request_id=xx123 partner=beta-bridge` Path: gs://redwood-staging-logs/beta-bridge/2026-04-02/0001.gz. Quick grep shows ~120 matches across last 72h.

dan: If there are both vault-transit items and raw tokens we need a two-track response: immediate SA/key revokes + bucket quarantine, and a planned rewrap for transit ciphertexts.

megan: I'll snapshot the bucket and copy suspect objects to gs://sec-evidence/INC-2026-142/ forensics. Will also add a read-only ACL for the DFIR team.

infra-oncall: Applying temporary deny binding to the bucket now to block partner ingestion SA. Leaving read-only access for sec & forensics. ETA 3m.

sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-142 created. Playbook: /wiki/incidents/secrets-exposure. Triage owners: @priya (KMS/Vault), @dan (SA key revocation), @alex (evidence & partner comms).

priya: Plan for KMS/Vault: 1) create new KMS key version, 2) rewrap transit ciphertexts where feasible, 3) rotate Vault transit keys and enable `require_wrapped_keys` on transit mount, 4) shorten wrapped token TTLs to 1h. Example commands:
```
# KMS create version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=transit-key --keyring=redwood-kr --location=global
# vault rewrap (pseudo)
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=\"<blob>\" to_key=projects/redwood-kr/locations/global/keyRNG/cryptoKeyVersions/2
```

dan: For SA keys I'm starting with the partner-relay SA used in ingestion: svc-beta-relay@redwood-inference. Steps: revoke existing keys, block new key creation via org policy in staging for 24h, and issue short-lived workload-identity tokens for any emergency needs. Commands:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-beta-relay@...
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-beta-relay@...
```

megan: For partner-facing customers we should mute the webhook and flip the feature-flag to queue messages rather than ingest. I'll coordinate with partner team for a brief window.

legal: Please hold partner notification draft until we confirm scope. We need number of unique tokens and any evidence of exfil. cc:security-ops.

alex: Running additional queries now across BigQuery logs to find plaintext tokens and wrapped ciphertexts. Query pattern: `jsonPayload.message:svc_token OR jsonPayload.message:vault:transit`. I'll dump results to gs://sec-evidence/INC-2026-142/scope.csv.

priya: Two questions for infra: are any downstream caches storing plaintext tokens (redis / memcache)? We must invalidate caches before partner rotation.

infra-oncall: Checking caches now. If found we'll rotate cache keys and flush. Also note: some ETL jobs archive logs into a separate bucket. I'm listing archive objects.

dan: After key revokes, we should perform a staggered partner rotation: 1) rotate internal bridge consumer keys, 2) ask partner to rotate their endpoint tokens, 3) full rotation of archived keys. Avoid rotating everything at once to reduce outage risk.

priya: On Vault config: enable verbose audit logging and stream audit to a hardened project. Add a BigQuery sink for 90d retention and immutable export. Set vault max_decrypt_age=3600 for transit.

megan: Evidence copy complete and ACLs set. Forensics has a read-only snapshot in gs://sec-evidence/INC-2026-142/. Leaving object manifest in the incident.

sec-bot: Audit export job scheduled by @priya. Org policy to block SA key creation applied to staging for 24h by @dan.

alex: Initial scope estimate: ~120 token occurrences, ~30 wrapped ciphertexts. No signs yet of external access but still investigating partners' delivery logs.

legal: If partners are potentially impacted we need to follow the coop disclosure timeline. Hold off on public comms until I review.

priya: Post-rewrap validation: run decryption checks using new key version on sample ciphertexts, then rotate consumer config to point at new key IDs. Also add a health-check endpoint so clients can detect rewrap failures.

dan: Leaving runbook note: revoke keys, create new keys, rotate consumers, verify ingestion. I'll document the gcloud commands in the incident ticket.

infra-oncall: Performed cache checks: found one Redis instance referencing `beta_bridge_token` key. Flushed and rotated credentials.

megan: Drafted partner message (technical & non-technical versions) and flagged legal. Will share in ~15m.

alex: Timeline estimate: containment 0-30m (bucket quarantine, ACLs done), rotations and rewraps 30-180m, audits & partner coordination 3-24h, full postmortem 72h.

priya: Recommended long-term mitigations: ban service-account key usage for partner ingestion, require workload identity, enforce `require_wrapped_keys`, shorten token TTLs, add automated detection rule for `svc_token` in logs with alerting to PagerDuty.

dan: Agreed. I'll follow up with a policy PR to block SA key creation in staging permanently and add a CI lint to catch commits that print tokens to logs.

megan: For closure: we'll need a final evidence bundle, a change log of IAM and KMS rotations, and an action tracker for permanent fixes.

sec-bot: Incident status \"containment\". Next check-in in 1h in #incidents.

alex: Thanks all. If you find new files matching `svc_token` run: `gsutil -m cp \"gs://redwood-staging-logs/**\" gs://sec-evidence/INC-2026-142/` and notify forensic lead.
